output.review_comment: Approving. The fix handles the tested cases with general rules and doesn't special-case any test. I couldn't run the suite myself, so the "all 9 tests pass" claim is the agent's. (1) Mixed-case words: the check `any(c.isupper() for c in word[1:])` runs before `capitalize()`, so "NASA" and "iPhone" are kept as written. (2) Last word: `index < last_index` does what the docstring already said (a small word in last position is capitalized), which the old code ignored. (3) Capitalizing the first word after a colon is standard title-case practice, not a hack for one test, and the agent added it to the docstring so the documented spec matches the code. Minor edge cases, not blocking: because the code splits on single spaces, a trailing space creates an empty last "word", so the real last word isn't treated as last. Also, `endswith(':')` misses a colon followed by other punctuation, such as `Field:"`. Consider adding tests for these later.
